findings.title: N+1: Author.books is loaded lazily 20 times per request

statements.sql: select b1_0.author_id,b1_0.id,b1_0.description,b1_0.isbn,b1_0.publication_year,p1_0.id,p1_0.country,p1_0.name,b1_0.title from book b1_0 left join publisher p1_0 on p1_0.id=b1_0.publisher_id where b1_0.author_id=?

findings.fix: Fetch it with the parent query (@EntityGraph(attributePaths = "books") or JOIN FETCH), or batch it (@BatchSize / hibernate.default_batch_fetch_size)

findings.title: Book.publisher is loaded EAGERly but never read: 3097 Publisher per request for nothing
findings.fix: Make it lazy: @ManyToOne(fetch = FetchType.LAZY), and fetch it explicitly where it is needed

findings.title: 5031 Book loaded per request, 1 of 4 columns read, large [description] never read
findings.fix: Select only what is used: a DTO or interface projection (select new ...(e.title)) instead of the entity

findings.title: JOIN FETCH + pagination: every matching row is read, then paginated in memory (26162 rows read per request)

evidence.warning: HHH90003004: firstResult/maxResults specified with collection fetch; applying in memory
evidence.statement: select distinct a1_0.id,a1_0.bio,a1_0.birth_date,b1_0.author_id,b1_0.id,b1_0.description,b1_0.isbn,b1_0.publication_year,b1_0.publisher_id,b1_0.title,a1_0.name,a1_0.ol_key from author a1_0 join book b1_0 on a1_0.id=b1_0.author_id where a1_0.name like (?||?) escape ? order by a1_0.id

findings.fix: Page the root ids first (query with LIMIT), then fetch the collection for those ids (JOIN FETCH ... WHERE id IN :ids), or @EntityGraph + @BatchSize

findings.title: Lazy loading outside any transaction, kept alive by open-in-view (spring.jpa.open-in-view)
findings.fix: Set spring.jpa.open-in-view=false and load what the response needs inside the @Transactional service (fetch plan or DTO projection)
